Clause 3 (Renewal). The returned copy reads: "of non-renewal at least thirty (30) days before the". We accept this change.
Clause 4.2 (Payment Terms). The returned copy reads: "each undisputed invoice within ninety (90) days of the". We do not accept this change as written. What we can agree to instead: We can extend payment to net forty-five days from the invoice date.
Clause 9 (Limitation of Liability). The returned copy reads: "this Agreement in the sixty (60) months before the". This change is under review on our side.
Clause 15 (Governing Law). The returned copy reads: "of the State of Oregon, without regard to". This change is under review on our side.

request.instructions: The source is the brief the reply was written from. A claim is supported only if the brief states the same decision about the same clause: accepted, countered with that exact position, or under review. A claim that promises something the brief does not state, or names a different term, is contradicted or not stated.
